libraryV2.heading: Ideas become part of the story
libraryV2.intro: Eleven families, one library. Your drafts and the versions you choose to share.
libraryV2.chooseFamily: What would you like to create?
libraryV2.familyHelp: Start with a name and description. Your draft stays in the library.
libraryV2.loadError: Could not load the library. Retained drafts remain available.
libraryV2.emptyHelp: Create content and choose its family.
libraryV2.storageError: Browser storage is unavailable. Keep this page open to retain your draft.
libraryV2.recordHelp: Existing copies and offers stay on their version.
libraryV2.recordFirst: Record a version before sharing. Your draft is saved.
libraryV2.nameRequired: Name your content before recording a version.
libraryV2.unchanged: The draft already matches the latest version.
libraryV2.noVersions: No versions yet. Your draft is saved.
libraryV2.reviewHelp: Compare the contents. Your draft stays intact; after review you can save it against the new base.
libraryV2.shareHelp: The recipient chooses whether to keep a copy. Only this version is offered.
libraryV2.sharingTitle: What passes from hand to hand
libraryV2.sharingIntro: Provenance stays. Revoking access stops future access, not a copy already granted.
libraryV2.updateHelp: Update only the selected copy. Other copies and instances in use keep their data.
libraryV2.revokeHelp: Anyone who already kept a copy retains it. The offer can no longer be accepted.
libraryV2.unavailableOffer: This offer is no longer available. Already granted copies are retained.
libraryV2.unknown: Outcome unknown. Check the receipt before retrying.
libraryV2.conflict: The contents changed. Your draft is retained.
libraryV2.rejected: Operation not authorized. Your data was not replaced.
libraryV2.invalidated: The context changed. Review your draft before saving.
libraryV2.requestFailed: Could not complete the request. Try again.
libraryV2.metadataHelp: Name and description explain the content; they do not automatically create mechanics.
libraryV2.invalidData: Check the fields: each tag can contain up to 80 characters. Your draft is retained.
libraryV2.incompatibleRecovery: A previous draft has an incompatible format. Download its original contents to recover them.
libraryV2.incompatibleRecord: Some content has an incompatible format. Other entries remain available. Download the original snapshot to recover it.
libraryV2.acceptHelp: Keep an independent copy in your library, with its source and version. Later changes to the original will not replace your copy.
libraryV2.storageUnsaved: Not saved — keep this page open
